dynamicsPresets.description: Recipes for the Limiter section (Bottom Right) to achieve different dynamic characters and saturation colors.

limiter_types_explained.Limiter: Clean, transparent peak limiting - no coloration
limiter_types_explained.Warming: Soft-knee compression with mild saturation - analog warmth
limiter_types_explained.Heating: Harder compression with noticeable saturation - aggressive
limiter_types_explained.Distortion: Hard clipping and overdrive - heavy coloration
limiter_types_explained.Custom: Preset-defined curve - varies by sound designer

presets.name: Transparent Safety
presets.description: Catches peaks without coloring the sound. Default behavior.
presets.sonic_character: Invisible limiting, maintains dynamic range, no harmonics added
when_to_use: When you need peak protection only
tips: Increase Pre slightly (5-10%) if preset is too quiet
This is the default for a reason - start here

presets.name: Analog Warmth
presets.description: Subtle saturation that thickens the sound, similar to tube gear.
presets.sonic_character: Warm, slightly compressed, adds even harmonics, glues elements together
when_to_use: Adding vintage character to digital sounds
tips: Push Pre to 40-50% for more obvious warmth
Combine with Master Filter Low Pass for vintage vibe
Works great on Rhodes, Wurlitzer, and organ sounds
presets.before_after: Before: Crisp, digital. After: Warm, slightly compressed, cohesive

presets.name: Hard Drive / Fuzz
presets.description: Heavy distortion that obliterates dynamics for maximum loudness.
presets.sonic_character: Distorted, saturated, aggressive, adds odd harmonics, compressed
tips: Crank Pre to 100% for maximum destruction
Use High Pass filter before this to avoid mud
Combine with resonant filter for acid sounds
presets.before_after: Before: Clean bass. After: Aggressive, distorted, cuts through mix
presets.warning: Can be very loud - adjust mixer level accordingly

presets.name: Parallel Glue
presets.use_case: Drum Loops, Pluck Chords, Dynamic Layers
presets.description: Mixes a heavily compressed signal with the clean signal for punch + transients.
presets.sonic_character: Punchy transients with added body and sustain
when_to_use: Adding body to drums without losing punch
tips: Mix at 30-50% for best results
Too much Mix loses transients
Great on chord stabs and plucks
presets.before_after: Before: Punchy but thin. After: Punchy AND thick

presets.name: Lo-Fi Crush
tips: Low Mix (20-30%) works best
Combine with Master Filter Low Pass @ 3-5kHz
Add noise/vinyl crackle macros if available
presets.before_after: Before: Clean, digital. After: Degraded, vintage, lo-fi

presets.name: Vocal Shine
presets.description: Gentle compression that brings vocals/leads forward without harshness.
when_to_use: Lead synths that need to cut through
tips: Keep Pre moderate (20-30%)
Too much Pre causes harshness
Combine with short reverb for depth
presets.before_after: Before: Buried in mix. After: Upfront and present

presets.name: Soft Tape Saturation
presets.description: Emulates analog tape saturation with soft knee compression.
presets.sonic_character: Smooth, analog, glues elements, adds weight
when_to_use: Adding analog character to full arrangements
tips: Use on busses/groups rather than individual sounds
Mix at 70-90% for tape blend
Pair with vintage-style reverbs
presets.before_after: Before: Clean but separate elements. After: Cohesive, warm, analog

presets.name: Aggressive Pump
presets.use_case: EDM Leads, Synth Stabs, High-Energy Elements
presets.description: Hard compression for maximum impact and energy.
tips: Reduce Pre if it clips (causing artifacts)
Works great with bright, cutting sounds
May need to reduce mixer level
presets.before_after: Before: Dynamic. After: Compressed, loud, aggressive
presets.warning: Very aggressive - can cause ear fatigue

presets.name: Subtle Enhancement
presets.description: Barely-there warmth that adds polish without obvious processing.
when_to_use: When you need transparency with slight warmth
tips: Very subtle - A/B test to hear difference
Don't push Pre above 20%
Great for adding "glue" without coloration
presets.before_after: Before: Pristine. After: Slightly more cohesive

presets.name: Bass Thickener
presets.description: Adds weight and harmonics to bass sounds without losing punch.
presets.sonic_character: Thick, punchy, adds harmonics for clarity on small speakers
when_to_use: Sub bass that disappears on laptop speakers
tips: Check in mono - bass should stay tight
Combine with Distortion type for aggressive bass
Keep bass completely dry (0% reverb)
presets.before_after: Before: Clean but thin bass. After: Thick, punchy, audible on all systems

workflow_tips: Start with 'Transparent Safety' and only add character if needed
Use Heating/Distortion for aggressive electronic genres
Always A/B test - your ears might be fatigued
common_mistakes: Using Distortion on everything - causes ear fatigue
Not adjusting mixer level after heavy limiting
Forgetting to check mono compatibility after saturation
Too much Pre causing unwanted clipping artifacts
